title: Which picture shows a half?
prompt: Look at the two pictures, A and B. In one of them exactly one half is coloured. Write the letter of that picture, and then write the fraction that is coloured.
reference_solution: A, and 1/2. Picture A is cut into 2 equal parts and 1 part is coloured. In picture B the two parts are not equal, so the coloured part is not a half.
grading: Correct: the letter A together with the fraction 1/2. Accept 1/2, one half, a half, 1 over 2, or the symbol for one half. The letter may be written as A, a or with a circle around it. Partial: only the letter A without any fraction, or only the fraction 1/2 without a letter. Incorrect: the letter B (with any fraction), or a fraction other than 1/2 (such as 2/1, 1/1 or 2). Common mistakes and what to tell the child: (1) B chosen because one of two parts is coloured: say that the two parts of B are not the same size, so the coloured part is not a half; a half needs two equal parts. (2) 2/1 or 2 written: say that the bottom number tells how many equal parts there are in all, so it is 2 on the bottom and 1 on top, as in 1/2. (3) 1/1: say that the whole picture has 2 parts, so the bottom number is 2.
hints: Count the parts in each picture. Then ask: are the parts the same size?
A half needs two equal parts. Which picture has two equal parts?
The bottom number is how many equal parts there are in all. The top number is how many are coloured.
